items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: We’re going to do our own thing, and then maybe play a couple of acoustic duets on the blue guitars.

ctx.x: And Scott Shinnery from New Jersey owns them all. He commissioned them all and they’re doing a thing in the Smithsonian. We’re going to do our own thing, and then maybe play a couple of acoustic duets on the blue guitars.
What’s it going to be called? Does it have a name for the exhibition?
